title: Fact-checking Trump’s speech at the United Nations General Assembly
title_en: Fact-checking Trump’s speech at the United Nations General Assembly
content: Donald Trump’s UN address was packed with claims that are misleading, false or exaggerated. He said the US has more munitions than it could ever use, despite reports of depleting stocks. Vedika Bahl fact-checks the speech in Truth or Fake.
